scope: IE-04/06/07/08: joint discrete update of17 voltage-dependent physical gates in10channels, exact vectorized readout; SK remains canonical after calcium update.
decision: Test whether replacing kinetic formulas and per-step time-constant exponentials, rather than cheap aperture products, yields a fidelity-qualified resident saving.
input_contract: All arms receive current V and same explicit18gate state; parameters remain analytic multipliers. Voltage-dependent coefficients do not require Ca. SK alone uses the identical new-Ca phase. No endpoint teacher inputs or memory reduction.
model: Shared1->width SiLU->34 output MLP: sigmoid u and sigmoid z times per-gate fixed positive zscale. x_next=(1-z)*x+z*u. Width32/64; transition-only versus transition+internal coefficients;12 independent members vectorized with paired streams, per-member Adam/clipping. Inference removes all padding.
zscale: Maximum exact z on a fixed4097-point training-domain grid times1.001, capped at1. Same constants for all learned arms; training-derived prior, not online teacher access.
loss: Per-gate transition residual divided by zscale, squared then averaged. Internal arms add mean squared u error and .01 mean squared log(z/zscale+1e-8) error. Sum member losses, never average across members. Fixed budget.
selection: Per member minimum development normalized transition RMSE, only registered checkpoints. Exact same development set and criterion. Freeze checkpoint hash before computing fresh outcomes.
data_contract: Independent uniform V and independent uniform17gate occupancy for fit/development/fresh. These are atomic samples, not physiological density. Formula targets; NumPy64 cross-check validates GPU17gate transitions. No new native confirmation claimed.
paths: 24 fresh imposed-voltage paths x400steps: constant, steps, sinusoid, chirp, pulse/recovery, bounded random walk,4paths each; independent initial gate occupancy and path seeds81702. Fresh paths evaluated after freeze only. 40ms atdt.1. Path support and per-family metrics saved.
validation: CPU/GPU vectorized-versus-independent prediction and clipped Adam preflight; exact17gate NumPy64 oracle cross-check; no compile fallback. Fullgraph and graph compared with their own eager maps. Technical failure is not model NO-GO; unavailable graph comparison is inconclusive. Check domain exits and occupancy violations.

hypotheses.H_direct: Joint coefficient inference can save>=10% versus exact vectorized formula core atb642 under shared CUDA Graph execution and all quality gates.
hypotheses.H_internal: At matched width/seed/budget, internal supervision reduces fresh and forced-path errors relative to transition-only.
hypotheses.H_capacity: At matched loss/seed/budget, width64 improves quality enough to justify extra measured cost.
hypotheses.H_lut: An interpolated numerical control may dominate learned coefficients; report this rather than crediting DL for cheap algebra or implementation overhead.

exclusions: No deployment promotion, no full morphology or axial coupling, no new native fresh confirmation, no larger time step, no latent-state compression, no speedup inferred from parameter count.
